user.current_work: Audit associate at a tier-2 accounting firm

user_snapshot: Married Accounting grad in Abuja, 2 years post-NYSC, audit associate at tier-2 firm on ₦220k with partner adding ₦160k, one child, ₦1.2m saved, and committed to japa inside 24 months.
headline_insight: Your combined ₦380k household income and ₦1.2m savings make you a rare profile: you can fund a real japa route while staying employed — but your Big 4 window has already closed, so the audit-to-PR pipeline runs through Canada Express Entry or UK ACCA-sponsored, not another Lagos firm.

routes.title: Canada Express Entry → Accountant PR (direct, no school)
routes.one_liner: Leverage your 2+ years audit experience + ACCA/ICAN to land Canadian PR and a CA$55-75k accountant role within 18-24 months.

fit_reasons.note: Japa appetite is 'committed' and 24-month horizon matches Express Entry timeline from profile to landing.
₦1.2m savings + ₦380k household income covers IELTS, WES, ICAS, and proof of funds for a family of 3.

break_reasons.risk: CRS score below 485 cutoff if IELTS comes back CLB 8 instead of CLB 9 — profile sits unused for 12+ months.

routes.who_this_fits: Disciplined self-studiers who can grind IELTS to CLB 9 while working full-time audit hours.
routes.who_this_breaks: Anyone who hopes a 7.0 IELTS will be 'enough' — CRS math is brutal and ties are rare.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Evenings and weekends for 6 months of IELTS + CFA/ACCA prep. ₦2m of savings converted to proof of funds (locked but recoverable).

real_pay.range_note: Canadian accountant salaries CA$55-95k. NGN figures at ~₦1,200/CA$. First 6 months post-landing often survival jobs before accounting role lands.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you execute the CRS playbook, you're landed in Calgary or Ottawa as a Staff Accountant earning CA$60k (₦6m/mo), partner reskilled into admin or healthcare support, child in public school, and CPA pathway started.
pro_tips: Book IELTS General — Academic doesn't count for Express Entry.
Claim spouse points: her formal job + IELTS adds 20+ CRS points.

monday_actions.step: Register for IELTS General at British Council Abuja for the nearest Saturday slot — ₦165k.
Open WES application for your B.Sc transcript; contact your uni's exams office for direct-send.
Join ConnectSafe Nigeria Telegram + r/ImmigrationCanada to benchmark your CRS against recent draws.

routes.nigerian_notes: Do NOT use agents charging ₦2m+ — Express Entry is a self-serve system. Use IRCC direct site. Spouse's formal employment is a CRS asset most Nigerians waste by not documenting it properly.

routes.title: ACCA + Remote Accountant/Finance Ops (USD, from Abuja)
routes.one_liner: Stack ACCA on your audit base, pivot to remote accountant or FP&A for US/UK startups earning $1.5-4k/mo while staying in Abuja.

fit_reasons.note: Your SQL + Excel + audit experience maps directly to remote finance ops roles — rare combo for Nigerian accountants.
Accounting 2:1 + 2 years tier-2 audit meets minimum bar for ACCA exemptions and US startup bookkeeper roles.

break_reasons.risk: Remote finance roles require client overlap hours — you said no night shifts, which kills most US-based roles (EST overlap is 2pm-11pm Lagos).

routes.who_this_fits: Accountants who can self-brand on LinkedIn and tolerate UK/EU client timezones (noon-8pm Lagos).
routes.who_this_breaks: People waiting for recruiters to find them — remote roles need active outbound.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Weekends for 12-18 months on ACCA papers. ₦900k across ACCA registration + 4-6 paper fees + study materials.

real_pay.range_note: Remote bookkeeper/accountant $1.5-5k/mo at ₦1,500/$. UK-timezone roles only given your no-night-shift rule.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you clear ACCA Applied Skills + land one solid UK client, you're billing £2,500/mo (₦3m+) remotely from Abuja, still with your partner, and using the USD runway to fund japa cleanly.
pro_tips: Target UK SMEs on LinkedIn — timezone works and ACCA is instantly legible.
List Xero + QuickBooks certifications — free and filter most job posts.

monday_actions.step: Register on ACCA Global website, claim exemptions with your B.Sc transcript (saves 4 papers).
Complete free Xero Advisor Certification online — 6 hours, instantly visible on LinkedIn.
DM 10 UK accounting firm owners on LinkedIn offering freelance month-end close support.

routes.nigerian_notes: Payoneer + Grey for USD receipt. Keep a domiciliary account. IRS W-8BEN if US clients. ACCA has Lagos + Abuja exam centres — book Abuja to save travel.

routes.title: Big 4 Experienced Hire → Senior Associate (Abuja/Lagos)
routes.one_liner: Jump from tier-2 to KPMG/PwC/EY/Deloitte as a 2-year experienced hire, double your salary, and use the Big 4 brand as your japa accelerator.

fit_reasons.note: Second Class Upper in Accounting from a federal uni clears Big 4 academic screens; 2 years tier-2 audit is the exact profile they hire laterally.
Abuja base works — KPMG, PwC, Deloitte all have Abuja offices with lighter competition than Lagos.

break_reasons.risk: Big 4 Abuja offices hire far less than Lagos; you may need to relocate, disrupting your partner's ₦160k job and childcare.

routes.who_this_fits: Audit associates hungry for brand, ready to grind 60-hour weeks for 2 years in exchange for global mobility.
routes.who_this_breaks: Parents who need predictable 5pm evenings — busy season destroys family rhythm.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Evenings for 2 months of technical interview prep. Possibly ₦600k/yr rent delta if forced to Lagos.

real_pay.range_note: Experienced-hire Senior Associate ₦450-650k start. Manager level ₦900k-1.4m in 3-4 years. Secondment to UK/Canada possible at Senior Manager level.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you land a Big 4 seat, you're a Senior Associate at PwC Abuja on ₦700k/mo, ICAN qualified, with an active secondment conversation to Canada or UAE — a cleaner japa path than Express Entry alone.
pro_tips: Apply during Q1 — Big 4 hires heavy Jan-March post-busy-season resignations.
Name-drop specific clients you've audited; generalist CVs get binned.

monday_actions.step: Apply on KPMG Nigeria, PwC Nigeria, EY Nigeria, Deloitte Nigeria career sites filtering 'Experienced Hire – Assurance'.
DM 5 Senior Associates at each firm on LinkedIn asking for a referral — referrals double interview rate.
Register for ICAN Skills level if not yet — mention in cover letter.

routes.nigerian_notes: Big 4 salaries in Abuja trail Lagos by ~10%. Your tier-2 audit brand matters less than your client names and technical depth — prepare IFRS 15/16 case studies.

routes.title: Agri-Export Side Business (sesame/hibiscus, Abuja-based)
routes.one_liner: Use your ₦500k risk capital + SQL/Excel skills to run a small sesame or hibiscus export trade from Abuja, targeting ₦200-400k/mo net in 18 months.

fit_reasons.note: ₦1.2m savings allows ₦500-700k working capital without touching japa fund or emergency buffer.
Abuja sits within 4-hour trucking of Nasarawa, Benue, and Kano hibiscus/sesame belts — logistics are viable.

break_reasons.risk: First-timer export fraud is endemic — one bad aggregator can wipe your ₦500k inside one shipment.

routes.who_this_fits: Methodical traders with rural family links or patience to visit farms physically before paying.
routes.who_this_breaks: Anyone trusting WhatsApp aggregators or skipping grading before payment.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: ₦500-700k of savings at real loss risk. Saturdays traveling to Nasarawa/Keffi aggregators for 6 months.

real_pay.range_note: Net profit, not revenue. Highly seasonal. First 6 months often break-even while you learn grading and aggregator trust.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you survive the learning tax, you're netting ₦300-400k/mo on top of your audit salary, with a small warehouse in Mararaba and a Dubai or Turkish buyer on retainer.
pro_tips: Never pay aggregators upfront — grade at pickup, pay on load.
Start with local wholesale before chasing export LCs.

monday_actions.step: Visit Karu or Mararaba market this Saturday, price sesame/hibiscus per bag, meet 3 aggregators.
Join 'Nigerian Agro Exporters' Telegram group — learn Bill of Lading + Form NXP basics.
Register business name with CAC online (₦20k) — needed for domiciliary and export paperwork.

milestones: First sale to Lagos exporter (indirect export)

routes.nigerian_notes: NEPC registration (₦50k) needed for direct export. FX volatility can wipe margins — price in USD, hedge via domiciliary. Middle-belt security: avoid personal travel to border LGAs.

routes_filtered_out.reason: Programme window requires entry within 12 months of NYSC; you are 2 years post-NYSC and must enter as experienced hire instead.
₦18-30m cost for a family of 3 is unreachable on ₦1.2m savings + ₦380k household income without debt; Express Entry delivers same outcome cheaper.

routes_filtered_out.route: US roles with EST hours / night audit shifts
routes_filtered_out.reason: Hard no on night shifts rules out most US-client remote finance roles (2pm-11pm Lagos overlap).
Hard no on MLM adjacencies and commission-only structures conflict with your medium risk tolerance and sole-earner-leaning household.
